big: In Q2 2026, gold ETFs saw about 45 tonnes of global outflows. Prices eased, the dollar strengthened and rate expectations rose. Gold has drivers, and they pull in different directions.

lines: Why did gold ETFs see outflows?

A strong dollar and higher rate expectations hurt gold. Rising real interest rates raise the cost of holding it. On the other side, geopolitical stress and central bank buying support prices. And in rupees, a weaker rupee adds to domestic returns.
